actions.name: Fleeting Form
actions.desc: The matriarch can magically disguise itself to resemble a humanoid of roughly similar size and shape for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. This illusion does not hold up to close scrutiny.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: The matriarch sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the matriarch that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The matriarch must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the matriarch is incapacitated. While charmed by the matriarch, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the matriarch, the target must move on its turn toward the matriarch by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the matriarch, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this matriarch's song for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Visage of Desire (1/Day)
actions.desc: The matriarch projects a vision into the minds of creatures within 30 feet of it that aren't constructs or undead, showing each creature achieving whatever it most desires. An affected creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

sb.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, Primordial, telepathy 60 ft. but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious

traits.desc: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kraken makes two tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with a use of Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, that creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the kraken's turns. One Medium or two smaller creatures can be swallowed at the same time. If the kraken takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in spaces within 10 feet of the kraken. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 40 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.desc: The kraken magically create a bolt of lightning, which can strike a target the kraken can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small humanoid. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Slash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

traits.name: Abolethic Vassal
traits.desc: The skum is permanently charmed by its aboleth master.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The skum can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Psychic Conditioning
traits.desc: The skum is immune to the frightened and charmed conditions unless they are from effects created by an aboleth.

traits.name: Water Dependency
traits.desc: The skum takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without exposure to water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skum makes three attacks: two with its trident and one with its Mind-Breaking Touch.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mind-Breaking Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws until the end of the skum's next turn.

sb.name: Thousand Teeth

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: Thousand Teeth can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Thousand Teeth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Thousand Teeth makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: Thousand Teeth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Lunge
legendary_actions.desc: Thousand Teeth moves up to half its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Thousand Teeth makes a bite attack.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Vampiric Jade Statue
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The statue is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the statue fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The statue makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, that creature becomes cursed by the statue. The curse lasts for 10 minutes. While the creature is cursed, the statue has advantage on all attacks against it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Bite
legendary_actions.desc: The statue makes one bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Blood Reaper
legendary_actions.desc: All creatures currently cursed by the statue and within 20 feet of it take 5 necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The statue moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Yalaga has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Yalaga's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]] (self only)

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Yalaga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Yalaga has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Poison Spray|poison spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|resistance]], [[Tools/Spells/Spare The Dying|spare the dying]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Friendship|animal friendship]], [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Detect Poison And Disease|detect poison and disease]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Sickness|ray of sickness]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|lesser restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Poison|protection from poison]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Animals|conjure animals]] (2 giant spiders), [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Divination|divination]], [[Tools/Spells/Freedom Of Movement|freedom of movement]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Insect Plague|insect plague]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Cure Wounds|mass cure wounds]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Yalaga makes two scourge attacks.

actions.name: Scourge
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage.
